title: Interview: device pairing and admin bootstrap
lead: Decide the exact pairing flow from ADR 0010.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: ADR 0010 fixes the approach (pair once, long-lived cookie), but not the flow details. Those details decide a non-technical household member's whole experience of getting started.

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body:
1. How is the first admin created: a one-time bootstrap token printed in the server log (recommended) or a CLI command?
2. Pairing method: QR code shown on the owner's phone or screen, scanned by their phone camera (recommended), or a one-time link sent by message?
3. Pairing link lifetime (recommend 10 minutes, single use).
4. Cookie lifetime: 1 year, sliding (recommended), or never expiring?
5. Roles: admin vs. member? Can members see admin pages?
6. What happens on an unpaired device: a friendly "ask the owner to pair this phone" page (recommended)?

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Ask the questions, batched, with recommendations.
2. Amend ADR 0010 with the flow details, and record the raw answers in `local/` (not committed).
3. Update the "People and device pairing" slice's Implement/Check with the decisions (`slicer edit`).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- ADR 0010 states the bootstrap, pairing, lifetime and roles.
- The dependent slice has no unresolved Owner input.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit only when the owner asks; no AI attribution.
